clips.title: The story
paras: At Loch Modan’s southern gate, Captain Rugelfuss faces a sudden trogg uprising. The stern dwarven officer organizes the defense of the border.

Captain Rugelfuss guards Loch Modan’s southern gateway from the Valley of Kings. With Alliance forces stretched thin across the world, Ironforge depends on veteran officers like him to defend its home territories. He sets aside military ceremony and turns his attention to the danger at the border.

Troggs are surging into the highlands from ancient caverns. They have overwhelmed outlying dwarven patrols and built fortified footholds nearby. Rugelfuss calls on capable travelers to thin their ranks and drive them back from the roadway, defending the King’s lands.
